node.title: L1 FPC5: M=4,t=2 full-petal payment
node.statement: At official rates 1/2 and 1/4, aggregate every first-owned full-petal FPC5 contributor with source size M=4 and exactly t=2 touched petals. Writing d=ell+s, the live family has root excess e=2s+1->infinity. Each touched pair injects into the proved 2s+2-dimensional coprime-pair petal-equation envelope; the exact cell additionally retains background-root, exactness, and first-owner guards. Official source arithmetic removes the codimension-zero endpoint. At the apparent sharp rate-half codimension-two boundary, every background point is forced to agree and the guarded locator slice has dimension and codimension ell-1. The required conclusion is a disjoint polynomial/profile payment of the remaining guarded split-core-locator locus across all first-owned sources and pairs.
node.attack_surface: count split core locators in the background-guarded congruence slice, beginning with the rate-half dimension-(ell-1) boundary, with source multiplicity and exactness preserved
node.falsifier: an official rate-half or rate-quarter first-owned M=4,t=2 family exceeding every polynomial and legitimate quotient/profile column
